violations.why: The ISR can reset v_fjord to 0 during init() after the task wrote a random value. The task then reads 0 instead of its own value.
The range check uses the value read on line 8. The ISR can zero v_fjord before line 13 re-reads it, so the check no longer matches the value used.
The increment on line 13 is a non-atomic read-modify-write. The ISR's reset can fall between the read and the write, and the write then stores a stale value plus one.
The ISR can overwrite the value written on line 22 before the increment on line 13 reads it. The increment then starts from 0 rather than the task's value.
